title: Probe-bench sprint log (week of Mar 8-12)
body:
Sprint log / standup notes — Probe bench (week of 2027-03-08 to 2027-03-12)

Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Rafael Gomez, Priya Nair, Owen Patel, Jia Liu (remote), occasional drop-ins from infra (Lena)

Purpose: capture experiments, quick evals, and unblock model-onboarding tasks for quantized inference probes. Informal running notes — mostly actionable items and short experiments.

1) Highlights this week
- Completed baseline pass for 7B model family on probe bench with 8-bit asymmetric quant (q8a). Results logged below.
- Onboarding prototype for model "mosaic-7b-rl" into our local probe runner; discovered KV-cache rewiring bug when sequence length > 2048.
- Small eval harness for instruction-following checks added; initial regression detected on answer verbosity for q8a vs fp16.

2) Quick experiment summaries (results are median across 5 runs unless stated)
- Experiment: q8a on mosaic-7b-rl (seq 512)
  - median latency: 73ms/token on A100-40G (single request stream)
  - GPU memory: 5.6GB peak (with ephemeral attention buffers)
  - perplexity delta vs fp16: +0.9
  - instruction-following F1 (toy eval set of 120 prompts): 0.82 (fp16 baseline 0.88)
  - Notes: verbosity drop on conditional generation; likely from scale parameter clipping in quant routine.

- Experiment: q4bit+KV-cache (mosaic-7b-rl)
  - stable for short sequences but faulty cache updates at step ~34 for some prompts (repro across seeds)
  - Action: Rafael to add extra cache-consistency log hooks to capture key mismatch. Jira AIM-2178 created.

- Experiment: quantized int8 symmetric vs asymmetric on llama-like config
  - asym q8a slightly worse on long-tail tokens but marginally faster in our kernel selection path.
  - Decision: keep q8a as default suggestion in Optimize tooling for latency-sensitive routes; mark as "quality-risk" in rollout notes.

3) Model onboarding notes (mosaic-7b-rl)
- Work done: conversion script (map weights -> quant format) added to onboarding repo, branch: github:redwood-inference/quant-probe#512.
- Blocker: KV-cache pointer arithmetic (difference between our runtime cache layout and model's inferred kv block layout). Leads to misaligned cache reads on longer contexts.
- Temporary mitigation: cap effective context to 2048 during canary deploys.
- Next steps: Owen to prototype a compatibility shim in runtime that translates old-layout to new-layout at load time. ETA: Thu 2027-03-18.

4) Eval harness and regression checks
- We added a small instruction-following harness: 120 prompts across 6 categories (summarization, Q&A, code, simple math, multi-step, persona). Baselines established for fp16.
- q8a shows systematic reduction in multi-step chain-of-thought completeness; hypothesis: decoder logits smoothing due to quant scale binning.
- Action: Priya to run targeted evals with temperature sweep (0.2, 0.5, 1.0) to see sensitivity. Deliverable: a short table in confluence by next Wednesday.

5) Observability / traces
- Added a lightweight dbg tag to token pipeline to capture pre/post-quantization activation histograms for failing prompts. Minimal perf overhead in debug builds.
- Rafael to upload sample histograms and attach to AIM-2178.

6) Operational playbook notes (canary rollout guidance)
- Recommendation for dedicated: for q8a rollout use canary traffic = 2% for 48 hours, automatic rollback on instruction-following F1 drop > 5% or latency increase > 12%.
- For hosted experiments run A/B at route-level with fixed seed prompts (50 prompts synthetic) and monitor cost-per-1000 tokens and F1.

7) Open risks and questions
- Risk: quant-induced hallucination drift on factoid prompts (observed in 6/120 prompts). Need larger eval set to verify.
- Risk: cache inconsistency could silently corrupt outputs; unit tests insufficient to catch layout mismatches.
- Question: should Optimize suggest q8a as the default for low-latency tiers given the measured quality delta? Vote deferred to product (linked).

8) Action items (owner — due date)
- Rafael: add cache-mismatch logs and reproduce minimal repro; update AIM-2178 — due 2027-03-15.
- Owen: prototype runtime shim for kv-layout translation; PR draft — due 2027-03-18.
- Priya: run temperature sweep + extended eval set (500 prompts) and post artifact to confluence — due 2027-03-17.
- Jia: instrument canary harness to collect per-seed metrics (F1, perplexity, latency) and wire to console dashboard — due 2027-03-19.
- Maya: draft short internal brief for product with recommendation options (keep q8a with canary + fallback vs default to q8symmetric) — due 2027-03-16.

9) Meeting notes / ad-hoc discussions
- 2027-03-09 sync with infra (Lena): agreed to temporary increase in ephemeral debug log retention for probe runners for 72 hours; infra to revert after RFC.
- 2027-03-10 mini-review with SRE: added a flamegraph capture for token pipeline when latency > 250ms/token to capture outliers during A/B.

10) Quick reminders / notes to self
- keep two reproducible seeds for every benchmark (seed 42, seed 2027).
- add a short README in the onboarding branch to explain kv-layout assumptions.
- save raw histograms as compressed artifacts to avoid large Drive usage.

Appendix — small log excerpt (raw)
--- sample prompt id: 20270309-17
fp16: step 0..40 output tokens consistent
q8a: divergence at token 33, repeated token "the" observed 3x leading to truncation
Captured activation max pre-quant: 9.8, post-quant max bin: 8.0
---

If you'd like I can split this into: short exec-summary (1-pager) + detailed experiment artifacts and a follow-up confluence page. For now this doc serves as the running weekly capture for the probe bench sprint.

-- Maya
